opening.text: I've come in because I have a cough and some pain. My nose is stuffy or I have a clear runny nose, and I'm getting greenish or yellowish discharge from it. I should mention I smoke cigarettes, I've been diagnosed with gastroesophageal reflux, and I've had pneumonia before.
